about.text: A traditional Georgian string cheese from Meskheti, made from sheep milk, braided in hot whey and matured packed into a clay pot.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.
Meskheti sheep's-milk string cheese: stretched in hot whey, braided, salted, dried, coated in skimmed cream and matured about 2 months packed in an inverted clay pot; not brined

facts.v: Curd stretched and folded in hot whey for up to 25 minutes into fine strands, soaked in salted water, hung to drain for 10 hours, then coated with the skimmed cream
Described as the most complicated of Georgian cheese techniques
